newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH COOP BANKS VOTE FOR NEW GROUP STRUCTURE.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH COOP BANKS VOTE FOR NEW GROUP STRUCTURE.

text.p: The Central Association of Finnish Cooperative Banks resolved to transform itself into a cooperative, which will be the central body of the bank group, OKOBANK said in a statement on distributed on Wednesday evening.

"In an extraordinary meeting held on January 8, 1997, the Representative Assembly of the Central Association of the Finnish Cooperative Bank resolved to change the Central Association into OKOBANK Group Central Cooperative," OKO said.
The member banks and OKOBANK will decide on accession to the cooperative and articles of association in their own meetings to be held later, it said.

OKOBANK said the change in the statutes was supported by the representatives of 189 member banks, which cast a total 1,201 votes, and it was opposed by the representatives of 98 member banks, casting 259 votes.
